cells.gaps: The latest figure, 76.3 per cent for 2024 by INE's national survey, is below 80 per cent.
cells.note: INE's 2024 continuous multi-purpose survey puts mobile phone ownership at 76.3 per cent of people aged 10 and over (CPV-005); a national survey for 2024 is used in place of the ITU estimate of 81.4 per cent, so 3. It is below the 80 per cent line.
